text:
```yaml
name: Check Devin PR Assignee

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify PR is assigned to devin
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const assignees = context.payload.pull_request.assignees.map(a => a.login);
            if (!assignees.includes('devin')) {
              core.setFailed(
                `PR must be assigned to devin. Current assignees: ${assignees.join(', ')}`
              );
            }
```
